1.consolidated_definition: Planta silvestre de hasta 2 m de altura, de tallo ramoso y estriado, hojas verdes profundamente divididas, con el envés de color verde claro o azulado y flores dispuestas en espigas de color verde amarillo; tiene diversos usos en la medicina popular. Asteraceae Ambrosia peruviana, A. cumanensis.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Wild plant growing up to 2 m in height, with a branched and striated stem, deeply divided green leaves, with the underside of a light green or bluish color, and flowers arranged in spikes of yellow-green color; it has various uses in folk medicine. Asteraceae Ambrosia peruviana, A. cumanensis.
